notes: Boot elvis (5.00) with four balls on trough switches 11-14 and the stacking opto 15 at 0, built-in mechanisms off. Walk the Portals service menu with the Black ENTER (public 0) and Green RIGHT (public -1) buttons: Portals, MAIN MENU (DIAG), DIAGNOSTICS MENU, one step right to COIL, COIL MENU (TEST), and enter the Single Coil Test, whose cursor starts on the + icon. 36 times: press Black on + to select the next coil (the display prints the number, the name and the wire colours the ROM holds for it), press Green to move to RUN, press Black to fire it once, and press Red to return to +.
